agent.notes: The project pins bpy==3.6.*, but PyPI no longer has it (only bpy>=4.2, which needs Python 3.11). I rebuilt both venvs by hand with Python 3.11: bpy 4.4 at the exclude-newer date, numpy<2 (bpy's compiled modules fail under numpy 2), coverage, and the add-on installed editable with --no-deps. These manual steps are recorded in rebuild.log. The workload registers the add-on in bpy and runs the repo's 14 spring-bone tests from tests/blender_test_spring_bone.py. It then simulates 4 armatures, each with a 12-joint chain and 3 sphere colliders, for 1000 steps of update_spring_bone1_animation, and prints a SHA-256 digest of the pose-bone heads. check.py passes: every changed line runs on both sides (18 on head, 3 on base), the outputs are equal, base takes 3.3 s, and the run without network works.
